verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only domestic-style venture work (seed, convertible and VC financings, plus investor-side counsel). Nothing documents international investors, flips or redomiciliations, or multi-jurisdiction financings. The international mentions (Madrid Protocol trademark filings, GDPR/PIPEDA privacy advice, a location-independent virtual model) are adjacent features, not cross-border venture work.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm documents cross-border venture work — international investors, flips/redomiciliations, or multi-jurisdiction financings
